Only competitors from Ohio are eligible for the title of Ohio Champion. See [Ohio Champion Title Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioChampionship2026#69800-ohio-champion-title-eligibility) for details.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
